items.title: 20.1.1 Benzene ka thermodynamic istehkaam aur resonance (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the stability of benzene and resonance (PDF 60-61).

blocks.text: Alkenes ki tarah Kekule ki banawat mein benzene ke double bonds hain, lekin yeh alkenes se kaheen zyada mustahkam hai. Is ka saboot heats of hydrogenation se milta hai: catalyst par hydrogen jorne se nikalne wali hararat, jis se har soorat mein cyclohexane banta hai. Cyclohexane kam tawanai ka mushtarka hawala hai.

items: Cyclohexene (aik C=C) ki hydrogenation 120 kJ/mol deti hai.
Is liye 1,3-cyclohexadiene (do C=C) se 240 kJ/mol aur farzi 1,3,5-cyclohexatriene (Kekule ki banawat, teen C=C) se 360 kJ/mol ki tawaqqo hai.
Benzene darasal sirf 208 kJ/mol deta hai, tawaqqo se 152 kJ/mol kam.

blocks.alt: Energy level diagram: energy oopar ki taraf aur cyclohexane neeche ki lakeer. Is ke oopar levels: farzi (hypothetical) cyclohexatriene 360 kJ/mol, 1,3-cyclohexadiene 240 kJ/mol, benzene 208 kJ/mol aur cyclohexene 120 kJ/mol; har aik ke saath us ki ring aur cyclohexane tak neeche teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.1: Cyclohexenes aur benzene ki hydrogenation ka energy level diagram (kitab ki Figure 20.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har level cyclohexane se apni qeemat (value) ki oonchai par bana hai: farzi cyclohexatriene 360, 1,3-cyclohexadiene 240, benzene 208 aur cyclohexene 120 kJ/mol.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har level cyclohexane se us ki apni qeemat ki oonchai par bana hai. Kitab ki tasweer mein levels apni qeematon par nahi: 1,3-cyclohexadiene aur benzene ke naam 240 wali lakeer se oopar aur cyclohexene 208 wali lakeer se oopar chhape hain. Sahi tarteeb: cyclohexatriene 360 (farzi), cyclohexadiene 240, benzene 208, cyclohexene 120. Benzene tawaqqo (360) se 152 kJ/mol kam hararat deta hai: yahi resonance energy hai.

blocks.title: Resonance aur resonance energy
blocks.text: Benzene ki asal banawat Kekule ki koi aik banawat nahi balke un ke darmiyan aik delocalised banawat hai; ise resonance kehte hain. Is ke pi electrons chhe ke chhe carbons par phaile hain. Resonance (delocalisation) energy woh izafi istehkaam hai jo yeh mahdood (localised) double bonds wali farzi banawat ke muqable mein deta hai: benzene ke liye 152 kJ/mol.

blocks.prompt: Heats of hydrogenation se dikhayein ke benzene ki resonance energy 152 kJ/mol hai.
blocks.explanation: Teen C=C ke liye tawaqqo: 3 x 120 = 360 kJ/mol. Benzene ki napi qeemat: 208 kJ/mol. Farq: 360 - 208 = 152 kJ/mol.

items: Resonance energy = 152 kJ/mol: benzene Kekule ki banawat se kaheen mustahkam.
